title: Souvenance — a self-hosted memory engine you own
description:
A self-hosted personal memory engine for AI assistants. Events are stored in an append-only PostgreSQL log owned by the subject; memories, embeddings and a bi-temporal knowledge graph are recomputable projections of that log. Nightly consolidation runs on a swappable AI backend, and the memory is served through MCP — so the model, the interface and the vendor stay replaceable while the substrate persists.

This archive includes the research/ folder: position papers and pre-registered evaluation protocols arguing and testing the architecture, with verified sources, an explicit list of rejected sources, and falsification criteria named in advance.
